==Description==
'''Classic Oof''' is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]]. This modifier changes the death sound of enemies.

'''Classic Oof''' is active in [[Classic Candy Cane Lane]], [[Classic Winter]], [[Classic Forest Camp]], [[Classic Island Chaos]] and [[Classic Castle]], which currently can only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It can also be activated on any mode in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.

==Effects==
When applied, '''Classic Oof''' will make enemies play the removed [https://youtu.be/3w-2gUSus34?si=nUE4E2O3LjSmyF-Y Roblox Oof] sound on death.
